# Aqua glass theme (community-maintained fork)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> **Upstream notice**: this package continues from **WYH66666666**'s [DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin](https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin) (published on npm as `dsh-client-ui-aqua`) at **v1.3.0**. The original author states he cannot keep up with new DSH APIs, so this fork fixes and adapts that code. It is **not guaranteed** to work with future DSH versions — back up your profile before upgrading DSH.

## Supported DSH version

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| **DSH desktop / web** | **V0.2.1-rc.3** |
| Host client packages | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` **0.2.1-rc.3** |
| Declared in metadata | `package.json` → `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0"` |

**V0.2.1-rc.3 is the version this release is built and verified against** — the theme hooks are read from that host build (page-head markup, composer/dock seams, slot names). These are private client surfaces, so a DSH upgrade can break the look or the mount even though nothing changes here. If you are on another DSH build, treat the theme as unsupported and keep a profile backup.

## Topics / community listing

Published under the `dsh-plugin` topic, so it shows up on the [dsh-plugin community page](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) alongside other DeepSeek Harness plugins.

`dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `deepseek-harness-plugin` · `theme` · `glassmorphism` · `aqua`

## Credits

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Original author | **WYH66666666** — [repository](https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin) |
| Upstream npm package | `dsh-client-ui-aqua` (latest 1.3.1) |
| Base of this fork | upstream **v1.3.0** sources |
| Maintained by | **ZHUBAI0528** — [repository](https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix) |
| This package | `@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix` |
| Version | **2.0.0** |
| **DSH support** | **V0.2.1-rc.3** |
| License | **AGPL-3.0** (inherited from upstream `LICENSE`; original copyright and licence notice retained verbatim) |

Aqua is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app. The floating header, composer and stats line, and the trajectory view become panes of frosted glass, while the main column can sit on the living fluid board or on your own wallpaper (image or video); the sidebar keeps its stock look. Switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source changes to DSH itself.

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## Differences from upstream v1.3.0

| Item | Upstream v1.3.0 | This package v2.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Layout modes | **Mica + Compatibility**, switchable | **Mica only** — compatibility mode and its selector are removed (tokens and styles too) |
| Edge blur bands | 5px gradient blur bands at the top/bottom (an upstream feature) | **Removed** — they read as an extra gradient wash over the page edges; readability is carried by the column veil instead (the 13px edge fade stays) |
| Submenu opacity | not available | **New** setting, default 96%, in the same group as "Chat surface opacity" |
| Submenu click | opens on hover, then a click closes it | **New "click keeps it open"**: a hover-opened submenu survives the click and closes on the next one; works at any depth via ARIA, keyboard Enter unaffected |
| Popup material | `62% × frost` fill (≈8.7% by default), text behind was legible through it | **96%** fill + `blur + 4px`, panels no longer show the text behind |
| Composer and stats line | two panes with a 6px gap | **one continuous piece of glass** (single radius, hairline divider) |
| Light-mode conversation area | if the host or a skin plugin wrote the column background, the veil lost and the area went all-white; the opacity knob did nothing | **Fixed**: the veil is `!important` and also matches `[class*='centerCol']`, so it no longer depends on stamp timing |
| Scheme switching | switching to dark left the backdrop light until a knob was touched | **Fixed**: the layer watches `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and recomputes the fluid palette, glow tone and brightness direction |
| Cold-start fluid | a GPU that was not ready permanently disabled the canvas (all-white in light mode) | **Fixed**: retried with backoff (up to 8 attempts, ~12s) |
| Published tarball | `files` omitted `cordis.patch.yml`, so installs never loaded | **Fixed**: the tarball ships `cordis.patch.yml` and `lib/*` |
| Dependency range | peer `^0.1.0-rc.5` (mismatched a 0.2.x host) | `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`, pinned to the host line the theme is built against |
| Licence statement | repo `LICENSE` is AGPL-3.0 while `package.json` said MIT | **Aligned**: both now declare AGPL-3.0 |

## Features (current)

- **Mica layout**: floating glass header, composer, stats line and trajectory view, with adjustable blur and frost
- **Theme control panel**: one page collects every knob — colours, wallpaper, opacity, blur and decor
- **No 3D tilt on the composer**: the 3D effect is gone — it interfered with text rendering
- **Free backdrop**: the living fluid board (hue and depth adjustable) or your own wallpaper — images and video both supported; wallpapers have their own blur and frost, video adds a brightness knob
- **Desktop scheme following**: tracks the desktop app's light/dark switch and re-tunes the palette, glow and brightness direction on its own
- **Background brightness**: follows the resolved scheme — dark 0–50 darkens, light 50–100 brightens, 50 is unchanged
- **Chat surface opacity**: 0 lets the wallpaper/fluid show untouched, 100 is an opaque slab
- **Submenu opacity**: fill strength for popups (menus, dropdowns, quick-invoke panels), independent of the cards
- **Submenu display**: popups get a 96% fill plus extra blur, so multi-level menus stay legible above the transcript
- **Submenu interaction → click keeps it open**: a hover-opened submenu stays open when clicked, and closes on the next click
- **Ambient decor**: particle whale (the deepseek.com/harness centerpiece), fish, and the interactive mesh — each toggleable
- **Hover effects → cursor glow**: a highlight that follows the pointer
- **Glossy "Harness" badge**: dark mode swaps the sidebar wordmark for the official nameplate pill
- **Edge fade**: a 13px fade so content melts into the viewport edges
- One switch: off restores the stock UI exactly and removes every effect

## Installation

> Upstream `dsh-client-ui-aqua` and this fork `@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix` must **not** be installed together — the profile would end up with two `ui-aqua` entries.

### Option 1: desktop app — install from the in-app plugins page (recommended)

Open **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3** and click **Plugins** in the left sidebar.

Click **Add plugin**, then enter the following in the "package name or address" field:

```
github:zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix
```

No npm and no terminal needed — the plugin is pulled from that GitHub repository's latest release. Reload the UI and it is on.

### Option 2: one-shot script (Windows)

The script **installs from npm by default**, so it is Option 3 with the typing done for you — plus it clears any stale junction left behind by an earlier link install.

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest 'https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix/raw/main/install.ps1' -OutFile install.ps1; .\install.ps1"
```

Options:

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-Profile desktop` | target profile (default `web`) |
| `-Version v2.0.1` | pin a version (default: npm's `latest`; the script reads the dist-tag and pins it, because pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` otherwise resolves to an older release) |
| `-DshHome <path>` | DSH home (default `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`) |
| `-Link` | **development only**, see below |

Flow: locate the `dsh` CLI, remove stale junctions in both known locations, then `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg[@version]>`.

**`-Link` is for development only**: it downloads the source, verifies `lib/client.js` against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, creates a junction in that profile's `node_modules` pointing at the clone

plugins.description: 本地出口代理（egress）桥：给只接受无凭据代理地址的消费方一个本地地址，账号密码在上游那一跳注入。失败即断联，无直连降级。 | DSH plugin: a local egress proxy that hands a credential-free proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, then injects the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed — no direct fallback, ever.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-proxy-egress

把「只接受**无凭据**代理地址的消费方」接到「需要账号密码的上游代理」上。

```
消费方 ──► http://127.0.0.1:8899 ──► 本插件（注入 Proxy-Authorization）──► 上游代理 ──► 目标
           （无认证，消费方只填这个）        （账号密码只在这里出现一次）
```

- **失败即断联**：上游不通、认证失败、被拒、超时 —— 一律关闭连接并给出分类原因。
  没有直连降级，没有兜底重试，**代码里不存在可以打开直连的开关**（配置里写 `allowDirectFallback` 会直接报错）。
- **零构建、零运行时依赖**：`plugin-src/` 即真源，不需要编译。
- **凭据不进模型通道**：工具只查状态、只跑验证，回传里只有指纹（sha256 前 8 位）。

---

## 一、它能保证什么，不能保证什么

| | 内容 | 可证明性 |
|---|---|---|
| **L1 代理层** | 进入本地监听的每一条连接只经上游转发；失败不创建到目标的直连 | **代码级，可测**（`scripts/smoke.mjs` + `scripts/faultcheck.mjs`） |
| **L2 消费方层** | 消费方是否真的把请求交给本监听、失败后是否自己 fallback | **本插件管不了**，只能取证 |
| **L3 系统层** | 整机强制出口 | **未实现、未验收**。需要防火墙白名单或独立网络环境 |

> 说人话：本插件保证「进来的一定走代理」，不保证「该进来的都进来了」。

---

## 二、安装

本插件是一个 DSH bundle（`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`）。

### A · 从 npm 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @yiyunet/dsh-proxy-egress
```

一条命令做两件事：装包，**并自动把它登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`** ——
DSH 装完会回读每个新增依赖的 `dsh.bundle` 声明再行登记；没有该声明的包只当普通依赖装上，
终端会给出 `installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer` 的警告。

把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名。

### B · 从源码安装（改造或调试时用）

1. 把本仓库放到本机任意目录。
2. profile 的 `package.json`：`dependencies` 里加
   `"@yiyunet/dsh-proxy-egress": "link:<本仓库绝对路径>"`，
   并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加 `"@yiyunet/dsh-proxy-egress"`。
3. **装出符号链接**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> install`。
   （`bundles` 是手改的，但链接不装出来，加载器就解析不到这个包。）

### 两种方式共同的收尾

4. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加**同 id 覆盖**行（见下面「三、配置」）。
   包自带的 patch 里，上游主机与凭据路径是**占位符** —— 不写覆盖行，插件不会启动
   （但四个工具仍可用，`proxy_egress_status` 会把缺什么直接列出来）。
5. **重启前预检**：`dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config`
   应当只看到**一行** `proxy-egress`，且带 `patched by ...cordis.patch.yml`。
   这一步能验证 YAML 语法与包解析，不用等重启才发现。
6. 重启宿主，然后问模型 `proxy_egress_status`。

> 不要手写 `$DSH_HOME` 下的插件包，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm —— 那是 install_bundle 的活。

装好后在 **设置 → 侧栏「出口代理」** 有一个面板（零构建客户端，`plugin-src/client/client.js`）：

- 看状态：监听、上游（脱敏）、凭据是否已配置（只给指纹）、连接计数、最近失败
- 触发验证：代理链路检查 / 故障注入检查 / 重启
- **改上游与监听**：协议、主机、端口、本地端口、期望出口 IP、不匹配时 warn/block
- **录入凭据**：人工在面板里敲账号密码，宿主写进凭据文件并重启代理
- **清除凭据**：删掉凭据文件（上游要认证时代理会停止，这是预期状态）

面板的改动存在插件自己的状态文件 `$DSH_HOME/proxy-egress/settings.json` 里，**不写进宿主的启动配置**——
面板写启动配置，一次手误就是宿主起不来，而纠正它的入口恰恰是这个面板。
两个来源并存时，面板会标出每个字段当前来自「面板」还是「配置文件」。

面板是**全项目唯一合法的凭据写入口**。模型工具永远收不到密码——工具参数会进对话记录、
工具调用日志与宿主审计；面板走的是本机 HTTP，只在人的通道里。
凭据只写不读：保存后输入框清空，界面只显示指纹。

---

## 三、配置

```yaml
# ⚠️ 用「同 id 顶层覆盖」，不要写 `- insert:`。
# 本包自带的 patch 已经插入过这一行；再 insert 一次会变成两个同 id 的行，
# 两个实例抢同一个端口（症状是 EADDRINUSE）。
- id: proxy-egress
  config:
    listen: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 8899 }   # 只允许回环
    upstream:
      type: 'http'             # http | https
      host: '203.0.113.9'      # 只写主机名/IP，端口另写
      port: 8080
    credentialSource: 'file'
    credentialFile: '<凭据文件绝对路径>'
    allowConnectPorts: [443]
    expectedEgressIps: ['203.0.113.9']
    egressMismatchAction: 'warn'   # warn | block
    selfCheck:
      enabled: true
      url: 'https://api.ipify.org?format=json'
```

凭据文件（UTF-8）：

```json
{ "username": "<账号>", "password": "<密码>" }
```

然后把消费方的代理地址填成 `http://127.0.0.1:8899` —— **不带任何账号密码**，这正是本插件存在的理由。

### 校验规则（不满足就不启动，不监听任何端口）

| 编号 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| V1 | `upstream.host` 不能含端口、不能带协议前缀；IPv6 必须写 `[地址]` |
| V2 | `username` / `password` 必须同时提供或同时留空 |
| V3 | 任何输出（状态、日志、错误）都不含密码，也不含完整账号 |
| V4 | 域名做 IDN → punycode 归一 |
| V5 | 配置变了，旧的检查结果要作废 |
| V6 | 校验不过就不启动；**端口被占用也不自增换端口** |

---

## 四、验证

```bash
npm test           # 纯逻辑 + 沙箱里真跑客户端面板（不需要宿主、不联网）
npm run smoke      # 离线端到端（假上游 + 假目标）
npm run faultcheck # 证明上游坏掉时不会直连
npm run verify     # 发布契约断言（入口存在、白名单自洽、无安装期脚本…）
npm run scan       # 公开前脱敏扫描（词表由 DSH_PRIVATE_TERMS 挂入，未设置则跳过）
npm run check      # 上面全部串起来跑；prepublishOnly 用的就是它
```

`npm test` 覆盖六个层次：

| 文件 | 守什么 |
|---|---|
| `test/parse.test.mjs` | IPv6 三分法、CONNECT 状态行、Basic、逐跳头剥离 |
| `test/config.test.mjs` | V1–V6、直连降级开关被拒、端口白名单非空 |
| `test/credentials.test.mjs` | 凭据文件只有两个键、密码逐字、BOM 容忍 |
| `test/overrides.test.mjs` | **改端口不能把上游账号搞丢**、白名单外的键不生效、来源标注 |
| `test/rpc.test.mjs` | 面板 RPC 信封、错误分级、**业务 ok:false 不走错误通道** |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 客户端文件能在沙箱里执行、只 require react、面板挂载与首帧渲染 |

`smoke.mjs` 用一个假上游代理和一个 TCP 回声目标，把六件事跑一遍：

1. 正常隧道建立、认证头由本插件注入
2. 上游 407 → `502 UPSTREAM_AUTH_FAILED`，**目标零连接**
3. 上游不可达 → `502 UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE`，**目标零连接**
4. 非白名单端口 → `403 CONNECT_PORT_NOT_ALLOWED`
5. 普通 HTTP 走绝对形式，**业务状态码原样透传**（429 不被改成 502）
6. 停止后端口释放（再连是 `ECONNREFUSED`）

装到宿主之后，还有两个模型工具可以跑：

- `proxy_egress_selfcheck` —— 经本地监听 → 上游 → 回显服务，量一次**实际出口 IP**
- `proxy_egress_faultcheck` —— 独立实例 + 诱饵端口，验证不直连

---

## 五、分类失败码

| `X-Egress-Reason` | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE` | 连不上上游（网络/端口/超时） |
| `UPSTREAM_AUTH_FAILED` | 上游回 401 或 407：账号密码不对，或凭据改过但没重启 |
| `UPSTREAM_REJECTED` | 上游明确拒绝该目标 |
| `UPSTREAM_MALFORMED_RESPONSE` | 上游响应解析不出来（按失败处理，不当成功） |
| `TUNNEL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT` | 上游接受了连接但不说话 |
| `HANDSHAKE_HEADER_TOO_LARGE` | 上游响应头超过上限 |
| `CONNECT_PORT_NOT_ALLOWED` | 目标端口不在白名单 |
| `PROXY_BLOCKED` | 处于阻断态（出口 IP 不匹配等） |
| `EGRESS_IP_MISMATCH` | 观测出口不在 `expectedEgressIps` |
| `CHECK_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | 回显服务本身不可用（**不代表代理坏**） |

---

## 六、几个必须说清楚的限制

1. **一次检查不能替代持续约束。** 自检只证明"那一刻、那条路径"。
2. **回显服务只观测它自己的出口。** 上游若按目标分流，不能推论模型 API 走同一出口。
3. **阻断态不中断已建立的隧道。** 因为隧道里的字节已经看不到边界；要更强的效果只能用系统隔离。
4. **HTTP 上游的 Basic 认证只是 Base64。** 上游若在公网，账号密码在链路上可被还原。走公网请优先 `type: 'https'`。
5. **SOCKS5 尚未实现。** 写了会明确报错，不会静默忽略。

---

## 七、许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Edit generated HTML on the rendered page inside the DSH sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH HTML Visual Editor

Edit a generated HTML file **on the rendered page itself** — no source code view.

English · [中文](#中文说明)

When an agent writes a report to `.html`, DeepSeek Harness shows it as source code.
This plugin adds a file viewer for `dsh-better-sidebar` that renders the document
and lets you edit the text, formatting and layout in place, then writes the result
back to the same file.

![Visual editor in action](assets/verification-0.1.1.png)

## Install

This plugin renders inside the **DSH Better Sidebar**, so install that first:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zimo-2233/dsh-html-visual-editor
```

The install comes straight from this repository; the published bundle
(`lib/client.js`) is committed, so there is no build step and no build-script
approval to grant.

`dsh-better-sidebar` 0.28.0 or newer is required. Without it the plugin stays
inert — it never breaks the app. Nothing else is started: no local server, no
browser extension, no API key, no network call at edit time.

## Use

1. Open a `.html` / `.htm` file in the right sidebar. The document renders as a page.
2. Press **Edit** in the sidebar header. The page becomes directly editable.
3. Select text to apply bold, italic, underline, heading level, font size, text
   colour, highlight, alignment, lists and links. Undo/redo work as usual.
4. Press the **save** button in the header, or `Ctrl/Cmd+S` inside the page.
   This is the only step that writes to the file — there is no autosave.
5. **Preview** shows your unsaved draft again without losing it.

**Rollback:** turn off “HTML 可视化编辑” in the sidebar settings’ viewer list, or
uninstall the plugin. The built-in HTML viewer returns; no other plugin is touched.

## What it saves

For a complete document with an explicit `<body>`, only the body is replaced. The
original doctype, `<head>` (including CSS, links and scripts), the body attributes
and everything after `</body>` are preserved byte for byte. Scripts inside the body
are kept, but they never run in the editor.

## Safety

- The preview runs in an iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` and **without**
  `allow-same-origin`, so the document gets an opaque origin.
- The page’s own scripts, event handlers, forms, frames and outbound connections
  are blocked. Only one nonce-bearing bridge script of this plugin may run.
- The parent window talks to the frame over a single `MessageChannel` port, checked
  against the window source, the opaque origin and a per-load random token.
- Saving goes through the sidebar’s existing authenticated write endpoint, so its
  request fence, file policies, encoding handling and mtime conflict check apply.
  A conflicting change is reported and never overwritten silently.
- Your HTML is not written to `localStorage`, not uploaded, and not sent to any AI
  service. Unsaved drafts live in memory for the current session only (five at most).
- The sidebar service is acquired lazily, so installing this plugin without
  `dsh-better-sidebar` leaves it inert instead of breaking the app.

## Limits

- Built for generated static reports, articles and assignment HTML — not a page
  design tool. There is no drag-and-drop layout, no image replacement, no AI rewrite.
- Pages that build their DOM at runtime (React/Vue apps, chart interactions) cannot
  be edited this way; open the original file in a browser for those.
- The body is re-serialised by the browser, so indentation, quoting style and other
  normalisation details may change. Byte-identical output is not promised for
  arbitrary HTML.
- Documents above 5 MiB are read-only. Without a reliable mtime the document can be
  edited and exported, but not written back.
- Closing a sidebar tab cannot be intercepted reliably; export the draft before you
  close it.

## Development

```sh
npm install
node scripts/build.mjs
npm test
```

The browser acceptance harness lives in `test/browser/`:

```sh
node scripts/build-browser.mjs
node test/browser/server.mjs <workspace-root> 8977
# open http://127.0.0.1:8977/
```

It exercises the real handshake in Chromium: 0.1.1 reaches the ready state in
under 50 ms, while 0.1.0 times out on every case — the regression that 0.1.1 fixes.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

# 中文说明

在 DSH 右侧栏里**直接编辑渲染后的 HTML 页面**，而不是切换到源码视图。

当智能体生成一份 `.html` 报告时，DeepSeek Harness 默认按源码显示它。本插件为
`dsh-better-sidebar` 提供一个文件查看器：先把文档渲染成页面，再让你在页面上直接
改文字、改格式，改完写回同一个文件。

![可视化编辑效果](assets/verification-0.1.1.png)

## 安装

本插件渲染在 **DSH Better Sidebar** 里，请先安装它：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zimo-2233/dsh-html-visual-editor
```

安装直接来自本仓库；构建产物（`lib/client.js`）已随仓库提交，因此没有构建步骤，
也不需要批准任何安装期脚本。

需要 `dsh-better-sidebar` 0.28.0 或更新版本。若未安装，本插件保持静默，不会影响
宿主运行。除此之外不启动任何服务：没有本地服务器、没有浏览器扩展、不需要 API
Key，编辑过程也不联网。

## 使用

1. 在右侧栏打开 `.html` / `.htm` 文件，文档以页面形式渲染。
2. 点侧栏顶部的**“编辑”**，页面即可直接编辑。
3. 选中文字可加粗、斜体、下划线、改标题级别、字号、文字颜色、背景色、对齐、
   列表与链接，撤销重做照常可用。
4. 点顶部的**保存**图标，或在页面内按 `Ctrl/Cmd+S`。只有这一步会写回文件，
   没有自动保存。
5. **“预览”**会显示当前未保存草稿，不会丢失。

**回退方式：**在侧栏设置的文件查看器列表里关掉“HTML 可视化编辑”，或卸载本插件，
即可回到内置 HTML 查看器，不影响其他插件。

## 保存行为

对带显式 `<body>` 的完整 HTML，只替换 body 内部：原始 doctype、`<head>`
（含 CSS、link、script）、body 属性以及 `</body>` 之后的内容都逐字节保留。body 里的
script 标签会保留，但在编辑器中不执行。

## 安全

- 预览运行在 `sandbox="allow-scripts"` 且**不包含** `allow-same-origin` 的 iframe 中，
  文档因此是不透明来源（opaque origin）。
- 原页面的脚本、事件处理器、表单、内嵌页面与主动连接全部被阻止，只有本插件带
  nonce 的引导脚本可以运行。
- 父子页面通过单条 `MessageChannel` 端口通信，并校验窗口来源、不透明来源与每次
  加载随机生成的 token。
- 保存走侧栏已有的鉴权写接口，继承它的请求防护、文件策略、编码处理与 mtime 冲突
  检查；文件被外部修改时会提示冲突，绝不静默覆盖。
- 你的 HTML 不写入 `localStorage`、不上传、也不发给任何 AI 服务。未保存草稿只存在
  于当前会话内存中（最多五份）。
- 侧栏服务是延迟获取的：没装 `dsh-better-sidebar` 时本插件保持静默，不会弄坏宿主。

## 限制

- 面向生成的静态报告、文章、作业 HTML，不是网页设计器：不提供拖拽布局、替换图片
  与 AI 改写。
- 运行时生成 DOM 的页面（React/Vue 应用、图表交互）无法这样编辑，请用浏览器打开
  原文件。
- body 会经浏览器重新序列化，缩进、引号风格等规范化细节可能变化，不承诺任意
  HTML 字节级无损。
- 超过 5 MiB 的文档只读；没有可靠 mtime 时可编辑、可导出，但不能写盘。
- 宿主无法可靠拦截侧栏标签的关闭动作，关闭前请先导出草稿。

## 开发

```sh
npm install
node scripts/build.mjs
npm test
```

真实浏览器验收在 `test/browser/`：

```sh
node scripts/build-browser.mjs
node test/browser/server.mjs <工作区根目录> 8977
# 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8977/
```

它在真实 Chromium 里跑完整握手：0.1.1 在 50 ms 内进入就绪态，0.1.0 全部用例超时
——这正是 0.1.1 修复的回归。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 陪伴型长期记忆 DSH 插件：分层记忆（对话→事实→场景→人格）、规则抽取、时间衰减检索，全本地文件、append-only 不丢数据。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-memory

**陪伴型长期记忆插件：分层记忆（对话 → 事实 → 场景 → 人格）、规则抽取、时间衰减检索。**
全本地文件、不调额外模型、不产生额外费用；append-only 存储，多进程写入不丢数据。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:ly2601620664/dsh-pet-memory
```

`Compatible with: dsh 0.2.x`（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`）

## 它做什么

| 层 | 内容 | 存储 |
|---|---|---|
| L3 人格/关系档案 | "我叫他笨蛋"、"关系阶段 3" | `persona.md` |
| L2 场景 | 一段对话的摘要 | `scenes.jsonl`（只追加） |
| L1 事实 | "他喜欢喝冰美式"、"约定：周末去爬山" | `facts.jsonl`（只追加） |
| 命中统计 | 每条事实被检索到几次 | `hits.jsonl`（只追加） |

三个注入点：

1. **`systemPrompt.section`** — 每轮把「人格 + 高价值记忆 + 相关场景」放进系统提示词
2. **工具** — `memory_search` / `memory_add` / `memory_profile`
3. **`session/event`** — 回合结束时用规则抽取新事实

## 数据目录

默认 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-memory`（通常 `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-memory`），可用 `config.dir` 或
`DSH_PET_MEMORY_DIR` 覆盖。

## 存储设计（为什么全是 append-only）

`facts.jsonl`、`hits.jsonl`、`scenes.jsonl` **只追加，永不整文件重写**。

原因：桌面端和 web 端是两个 DSH 进程，共用同一个数据目录。任何"读全量 → 改内存 →
整文件替换"的写入，都会用自己那份旧快照抹掉另一个进程刚追加的行。早期版本用
`tmp + rename` 做命中统计，实测会让另一个进程写入的 40 条记忆**全部消失**。

现在的做法：
- 每条事实/命中/场景都追加一行
- 读取时**折叠**：同 `kind+text` 合并为一条，`salience` 取最大、`ts` 取最早、`hits` 累加
- 命中统计单独文件，`touch()` 完全不碰 `facts.jsonl` 正文

## 修复过的严重问题

| 问题 | 后果 | 修法 |
|---|---|---|
| `touch()` 用 tmp+rename 全量重写 | 多进程并发时丢数据（实测 40 条全灭） | 拆出 `hits.jsonl`，append-only |
| section 未设 `interpolate: false` | 记忆里出现 `{{` 会让整轮 prompt 渲染抛错 | 设 `interpolate: false` + 渲染前 `neutralize()` |
| `textOf` 用空格拼接 block | 行首锚定的清洗规则全部失效（实测 83% 场景被污染） | 改用 `\n` 拼接 |
| `textOf` 不区分 block 类型 | 助手**内心推理**被当成"他说的话"写进记忆 | 只取 `type === 'text'` |
| `hits.includes(f.text)` 字符串子串匹配 | `limit=1` 误伤多条 | 改用对象数组按 `id` 匹配 |
| `addScene` 无去重 | fork/compaction 重放导致重复场景 | 按 summary 去重 |
| `catch {}` 静默 | 落盘失败零日志，"以为在记其实没记" | 统一 `warn` 日志 |
| 无注入防护 | 粘贴的第三方文本可把指令写进长期记忆 | `isPromptInjection()` 拦截 |

## 开发

```bash
node test/selftest.mjs        # 抽取/存储/检索基础行为
node test/plugin.test.mjs     # 用假 ctx 跑一遍插件生命周期
node test/regression.test.mjs # 上面每个已修缺陷的回归用例
```

## 配置

```yaml
dir: null            # 数据目录，默认 $DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-memory
maxItems: 6          # 系统提示词里放几条事实
includeScenes: true  # 是否把相关场景也放进提示词
verbose: false       # 打印每轮抽取条数
migrateFrom: null    # 一次性导入旧 memory.md 的路径
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: dsh-doubt — evidence-first completion guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): pre-execution live-mutation gate, tool-evidence final-answer review, and verify_claims. 用实测证据替代“你确定吗”。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-doubt [![CI](https://github.com/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt?display_name=tag)](https://github.com/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt/releases/latest) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4B32C3)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20macOS-lightgrey)](#requirements) [![Topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-12%20suites-brightgreen)](https://github.com/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![中文文档](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3-blue)](docs/zh/README.md) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.7-blue)

English · 中文 · 中文文档

A completion guard for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) agents. It checks the *real tool evidence* behind an answer before that answer is shown, so a model cannot pass off an unverified claim as a completed task. > 中文说明：[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) · [中文文档索引](docs/zh/README.md) ## Why Agent answers often sound finished before the work is actually verified: a file was written but never read back, a dependency was guessed, a command was never run. The default failure mode is confident prose plus an unsupported claim. `dsh-doubt` adds a review boundary at the end of the turn. It does not ask the model whether it is sure; it checks what actually happened in the session. ## What it does - **Pre-execution gate** — dangerous live-host mutations (writes into `.dsh/profiles` or `.dsh/plugins`, process kills, service/registry changes, recursive deletes, system directories) are routed through the host approval seam; with no approval channel they are denied before the tool body runs. - **Final-answer review** — before a final answer is displayed, a tool-less reviewer compares every actionable claim (commands, paths, versions, symbols, measured numbers) against the turn's actual tool calls and results. Rejected drafts are never shown; when review cannot complete the draft is released fail-open with an explicit status. - **`verify_claims` tool** — runs submitted checks locally (command / file / HTTP / expression) and returns measured output, so claims can be grounded in real results. - **Provenance for deliverables** — when a Markdown/TXT deliverable is written without inline source annotations, a step-by-step provenance table is requested. - **Live-mutation guard** — an executed live mutation must disclose a backup location, an executable rollback command, and a post-action health check. The review is an evidence check, not a correctness guarantee. ### Token usage and loop protection Internal `doubt_review` receipts are hidden from the model's tool list while remaining executable by the host. Stale model-authored receipt calls cannot spin the agent indefinitely: other tools in a mixed response still run; a receipt-only response stops with an explicit incomplete-verification notice. Normal automatic evidence recovery remains available. Review-attempt logs include provider-reported token counters when available; missing usage is unknown, not zero. See the [token audit](docs/token-audit-2026-10-21.md) for scope and verification details. ## How it fits together ![dsh-doubt request flow](assets/architecture.svg) Tool calls pass through the execution gate; the final answer passes through a tool-less evidence review before display. See [architecture](docs/architecture.md) for the boundaries and [configuration](docs/configuration.md) for every option. ## Requirements - Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24` - DSH desktop app or host bundle for the integration tests (`verify:host*`) - Tested against DSH desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.2`; see [compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) - Windows is the primary platform; Linux/macOS are supported for development and CI ## Install ### DSH plugin manager (recommended) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt#v0.1.7 ``` Restart the harness and refresh the UI; the plugin is managed under **Settings → Plugins** and can be enabled or disabled there. Pin a tag or commit for reproducible installs. ### Windows desktop (offline installer) Download the `dsh-doubt-0.1.7-source.zip` release asset (or clone the `v0.1.7` tag), then run PowerShell from the unpacked source directory: ```powershell pnpm install node .\scripts\install-local.mjs --profile desktop cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" pnpm install --offline ``` The installer builds the plugin, copies `lib/`, config, assets and docs into `$DSH_HOME\plugins\dsh-doubt`, backs up the profile `package.json`, and adds the dependency and bundle to the selected profile. Back up the existing plugin directory first if you are upgrading. Restart DSH afterward; if the plugin is disabled in the profile config, enable it explicitly. Use `--profile ` for a profile other than `desktop`. The profile directory must already exist. ### From source ```bash git clone --branch v0.1.7 https://github.com/Yangxingyu789/dsh-doubt.git cd dsh-doubt pnpm install node scripts/install-local.mjs --profile desktop ``` For development rather than installation: ```bash pnpm install npm run build npm test ``` ## Quick start After restarting DSH, ask a question that requires real evidence, for example: > Read `package.json` and answer with only its version. The final answer is held until the review compares it with the actual `read` result. Use `verify_claims` when you want a claim checked directly. Review attempts are logged as `审核用量` with character counts and provider usage; prompts, tool payloads and credentials are not logged. ## Configuration (excerpt) All options live under the plugin's `config:` block (see [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)). | Key | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `guardPreExecute` | `true` | Ask/deny dangerous live mutations before the tool runs | | `guardLiveMutation` | `true` | Require backup + rollback + health check for executed live mutations | | `requireOperationEvidence` | `true` | Review the final answer against tool evidence | | `reviewMaterialOnly` | `true` | Skip the reviewer when a draft has no actionable claims | | `reviewNotice` | `off` | Trailing notice after an incomplete review: `banner` / `short` / `off` | | `requireProvenance` | `true` | Require a provenance table for annotation-free deliverables | ## Versioning and release history - **Public release series: `0.1.x`.** The first public release was `0.1.0`. - `0.7.x` and `0.8.x` tags are pre-public development history. They are not installation targets and do not sort as newer public releases. - Use the latest `v0.1.x` GitHub Release and its source asset. The plugin version is reported in `package.json`, `dsh-plugin.json` and the runtime plugin banner. ## Limits - The gate and scanner are heuristics over commands and text; unusual quoting, variables, nested shells or otherwise encoded payloads can be classified conservatively (deny/ask) or missed. **The gate is not a security boundary.** - The final review depends on a model provider call. When it cannot complete, the answer is released fail-open; logs record the failure but the default `reviewNotice: off` does not add a visible notice. Review also consumes model tokens. - The reviewer checks evidence, not semantic correctness or user intent. A claim that is a restatement of the user's own wording can be treated as user context rather than a new factual assertion. - Windows is the primary target; Linux/macOS support cov

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-lan · 桌宠联机

给已安装的 **`dsh-pet` 0.3.7** 加一个局域网联机层：同一 Wi-Fi / 局域网里，装了本插件的 DSH 会互相广播桌宠，远端桌宠显示在桌面透明小窗或 DSH 浏览器浮层里，可以打招呼、点击挤压、拖拽抛掷，位置自动保存。

> 需要 `dsh-pet` 0.3.7（带 `/dsh-pet-7340` 路由的版本），并且桌宠已经可见。  
> 本插件不修改 DSH 本体；**可选的实时状态补丁**会修改 `dsh-pet` 的运行时文件，详见下文。  
> 点击/拖拽/抛掷只作用于插件显示的**远端桌宠**；本机自己的 dsh-pet 不在控制范围内。

## 功能

- **局域网发现**：UDP 广播，同一房间名 + 端口的 DSH 互相可见，不经过任何外部服务器。
- **远端桌宠**：桌面透明小窗（默认）或 DSH 窗口内浮层；可拖拽、抛掷，桌面窗口位置按 peer 保存。
- **点击挤压 + 小黄鸭音效**：点击远端桌宠会上下挤压一下，并用 Web Audio 合成一声小黄鸭吱吱声（不需要额外音频文件）。
- **拖拽 / 抛掷 / 反弹**：按住拖动，松手按拖动速度抛出；桌宠受重力下落，碰到屏幕边缘/地面会反弹并逐渐停下。桌面窗口和浏览器浮层都支持；桌面窗口位置会持久化，浏览器浮层位置在本次会话内保留。
- **名字标签 / 打招呼**：点击名字标签上的 👋 按钮，对方桌宠会说一句短问候并播放动作；点击宠物本体只做挤压/音效，不会误发打招呼。
- **实时动作 / 气泡 / 表情包（可选）**：运行附带的补丁后，对方的动画、折叠气泡和表情包会同步过来；不跑补丁也能联机，只是远端宠物本地随机动作、没有实时气泡。
- **设置页「桌宠联机」**：显示方式（桌面 / 浏览器 / 两者）、房间名、端口、气泡共享、是否接受打招呼、在线列表、桌面窗口状态与收发诊断。
- **浏览器回退**：没有 Electron 或桌面 helper 启动失败时，自动在 DSH 窗口内显示远端桌宠。

## 安装

### 1. 先装 dsh-pet

在 DSH 插件市场安装并启用 **`dsh-pet` 0.3.7**，确认桌宠正常显示。

### 2. 安装本插件

在插件市场搜索 **`dsh-pet-lan`** 安装，或者：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-lan
```

桌面应用把 `web` 换成 `desktop`。

### 3. 配置

打开 **设置 → 桌宠联机**：

- **房间名 / 端口**：同一局域网的设备必须填相同值（默认 `dsh-pet` / `41234`，可自行修改）。
- **显示方式**：桌面窗口（默认，需要 Electron）、浏览器浮层，或两者。
- **广播气泡文字**：关闭后只同步动作和位置，不广播气泡文本。
- **接受打招呼**：关闭后忽略别人发来的挥手。

### 4. 可选：实时状态补丁

实时动作 / 气泡 / 表情包同步需要给 `dsh-pet` 打一个小补丁（**不是自动执行的**）：

```powershell
node <插件目录>\scripts\patch-dsh-pet.mjs
```

补丁会修改 `dsh-pet` 的 4 个运行时文件：

- `lib/client.js`
- `runtime/electron-helper/preload.js`
- `runtime/electron-helper/main.js`
- `runtime/electron-helper/sprite.js`

原文件会备份为 `*.dsh-pet-lan.bak`。补丁是幂等的，dsh-pet 升级后需要重新运行一次。

> **安全提示**：这是对另一个 npm 包的原地修改。运行前请确认你信任本插件，并保留备份；如果不想修改 dsh-pet，跳过这一步，联机功能仍然可用。恢复时把对应的 `.dsh-pet-lan.bak` 改回原名即可。

## 安全 / 隐私

- 联机数据走**局域网 UDP 明文广播**，没有加密，也没有身份认证；房间名不是密码，同一局域网内知道房间名的人可以伪造桌宠或发送打招呼。
- 广播内容：桌宠名称、主机名、视口、桌宠位置；开启“广播气泡文字”时还包括气泡文本（可能包含对话内容）和表情包名。
- 只建议在**可信的专用局域网**使用；不要在公共 Wi-Fi 上开启。
- 不接受来自非回环地址的 HTTP 控制请求；UDP 侧有 peer 数量、每 IP 包速率和全局限流。
- 不访问外部网络、不上传遥测；所有状态文件都在 `$DSH_HOME` 下。
- 可选的 dsh-pet 补丁会修改另一个包的运行时文件；这是本插件唯一的“包外写入”，已在上面单独说明。

更完整的威胁模型见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

## 显示方式

- **桌面窗口**：每个远端桌宠一个透明、置顶、可拖拽的小窗；鼠标不在桌宠上时点击穿透。需要 Electron（`dsh-pet` 桌面模式安装时通常已下载到 `$DSH_HOME/electron`）。
- **浏览器浮层**：远端桌宠显示在 DSH 窗口内，适合没有 Electron 的环境。
- **两者**：同时显示。

Electron 缺失或桌面 helper 启动失败时自动退回浏览器浮层；设置页会显示错误原因。

## Windows 防火墙

首次运行可能弹出防火墙提示：允许**专用网络的 UDP 入站**（默认端口 `41234`）。如果点了取消，用管理员 PowerShell 补一条：

```powershell
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "dsh-pet-lan" -Direction Inbound -Protocol UDP -LocalPort 41234 -Action Allow -Profile Private
```

## 协议

- UDP 广播，默认端口 `41234`，约每 1500 ms 一次 presence，6.5 秒无消息即下线。
- 房间名过滤；presence 里带桌宠列表、主机名、视口和可选实时状态。
- 挥手是单播 `wave` 消息；收到后在本地调用 dsh-pet 的 `/broadcast` 和 `/anim`。
- 协议版本 `v: 1`；实现见 `lib/index.js`。

## 卸载 / 回退

1. 在插件市场或 profile 里移除 `dsh-pet-lan`。
2. 如果运行过实时状态补丁，把 `dsh-pet` 下的 `*.dsh-pet-lan.bak` 恢复为原文件名。
3. 配置文件在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-lan.json`，可删除。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（已测试）
- `dsh-pet` `0.3.7`
- Node.js 22+

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: your DeepSeek account balance as a colour-banded bar on the right edge, with per-turn cost prediction and a quiet low-balance warning.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-guard

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that pins your
**DeepSeek account balance** to the right edge of the GUI as a quiet colour-coded rail, and
**projects what the current task will cost** before the balance runs out.

Nothing else changes hands: the balance comes from the DSH account you are already signed into,
the API key is never read, and no message content leaves the Host.

```
                                                          ╭──────────────╮
                                                          │ ●  ¥128.40   │ ← 20px chip, always visible
                                                          ╰──────────────╯
                                                       ┌────────────────────────────┐
                                                       │ 账户余额            ● 余额充足 │
                                                       │ ¥128.40                    │
                                                       │ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░░ │ ← 4px rail / meter
                                                       │ 本轮已花 ¥0.42  还需 ¥0.90–2.30 │
                                                       │ 估算依据 ▾                 │
                                                       │ 更新于 12 秒前      刷新 去充值 │
                                                       └────────────────────────────┘
```

| Balance (account currency) | Band | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `< 10` | **red** | about to run dry |
| `10 – 30` | **orange** | top up soon |
| `30 – 50` | **green** | fine |
| `> 50` | **blue** | plenty (the excess over the 50 mark is stated in the panel) |

Every colour, radius, shadow and type size comes from the shell's own `--dsw-*` tokens; there is
no custom palette and no animation beyond a 160–240ms transition. Hover shows a read-only preview
of the panel, clicking pins it, `Esc` or a click outside closes it.

## 中文速览

- 界面最右缘一根 **4px 极简轨道**，按余额比例填充；旁边常驻一个 **20px 小胶囊**（语义色点 + 金额）。
- 颜色：`<10` 红、`10–30` 橙、`30–50` 绿、`>50` 蓝；`>50` 的超出部分在面板里以「超刻度 ¥x」说明，
  不再有波浪动画。
- 悬停 = 只读预览面板；点击 = 固定面板（`Esc` 或点击外部关闭）。面板里给出**本轮已花 / 预计还需区间**；
  预计不够跑完时胶囊上出现「!」徽标、面板里一行红字写缺口（不弹窗、不发声）。
- 余额来自已登录的 **DSH 账号**，不读 API Key；卡片可展开「估算依据」（步数、缓存命中、峰谷价）。
- 全部视觉走 DSH 主题令牌：11/12/13/16 字号阶、R8/R12/R16 圆角、系统面板阴影；无自定义色板。

## What it predicts

「当前任务」= **the running turn of the current root session** (`turn/start` → `turn/end`).

- **Already spent** is provider truth: the four billed buckets of the turn
  (`uncachedInputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `outputTokens`) read as a delta
  against the cumulative `tokenUsage` session projection, priced by the current model and period.
- **Still to come** is projected per step: the next prompt size comes from the provider-anchored
  `contextPressure.projectedTokens`, output and prompt growth come from this turn's samples
  (falling back to configured defaults), and the cache-hit ratio is measured from the turn so far.
- **How many steps are left** is the mean steps-per-turn of this session's completed turns
  (default 8 when there is no history). The card reports a **minimum / expected / maximum**:
  one more step, the expected remaining steps, and twice the expected steps with a 10-point-worse
  cache hit and peak prices.
- **Verdict**: `required = expectedRemaining × 1.2 + reserve`, compared against the balance minus
  spend that landed *after* the balance reading (Platform balance lags by minutes). Balance at or
  below the line is "insufficient".

When no turn is running, the same card estimates the **next** task from the last three turns
instead of pretending to know the future.

## Requirements

- A DSH client with the DeepSeek account signed in. The guard reads the balance through
  `ctx.deepseekAccount`; the account token never reaches the renderer, and no API key is read.
- Node 20+ only for the test/install scripts; the plugin itself has **no build step**.

## Where the number comes from

`ctx.deepseekAccount.getState()` and `getBalance()` — the same service the client's account menu
uses, so the bar always agrees with what the client reports. **`getState()` is async**; reading it
synchronously once made every signed-in account look signed out, which is why the account section
of this file points that out twice.

The card names the source (`余额来源：DSH 账号`). A reading that fails after a successful one stays
on screen, clearly labelled with the error; an explicit sign-out clears the figure and the bar turns
grey.

## Install

The plugin is not published to npm; it loads straight from a checkout.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/marksimZ/dsh-balance-guard.git dsh-balance-guard
```

Then either pass the overlay for one run:

```sh
dsh web --patch /absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-guard/cordis.patch.yml
```

…or make it permanent by appending the row to a profile's own patch layer, which reloads live
(no restart, just reload the page). The installer picks `desktop` when that profile exists and
`web` otherwise:

```sh
node scripts/install.mjs            # writes $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
node scripts/install.mjs --dry-run  # show the exact result first
node scripts/install.mjs --profile web
```

> **`cordis.patch.yml` ships a machine-specific absolute path.** Edit that line (or let
> `install.mjs` write it) to point at wherever you cloned this repository.

Verify the running GUI actually serves it:

```sh
node scripts/verify-deployed.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>
```

## Configuration

Every key is optional; defaults live in `cordis.patch.yml`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `safetyRatio` | `0.2` | Multiplier over the expected remaining cost |
| `minReserveCny` | `2` | Amount that must stay untouched (account-currency units) |
| `balanceTtlMs` | `25000` | How long a balance reading is served |
| `balancePollMs` | `30000` | Background balance refresh cadence |
| `balanceTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one balance read |
| `runningPollHintMs` | `1000` | Browser poll hint while a turn runs |
| `idlePollMs` | `15000` | Browser poll cadence while idle |
| `cnyPerUsd` | `7.2` | CNY per USD for the USD-quoted price catalog |
| `assumedSteps` | `8` | Remaining steps when the session has no history |
| `assumedOutputTokens` | `1200` | Output tokens per step without a sample |
| `assumedGrowthTokens` | `4000` | Prompt growth per step without a sample |
| `assumedCacheHit` | `0.85` | Cache-hit ratio without a prompt sample |
| `holidays` | `[]` | UTC dates DeepSeek bills at off-peak all day |
| `balanceLagCompensation` | `true` | Subtract spend that landed after the reading |
| `clientVersion` | `""` | Client version used when the page cannot report one |

Prices live in [`src/policy.js`](src/policy.js) as `PRICE_TABLE` (USD per 1M tokens, peak and
off-peak rows for `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`), with the fetch date and source URL in
the file header. Peak is Monday–Friday `01:00–04:00` and `06:00–10:00` UTC, excluding the dates
listed in `holidays`; everything else is off-peak. Changing a price is a two-file change:
`policy.js` plus the value pinned in `scripts/policy-spec.mjs`.

## Architecture

Two halves, one plugin.

```text
Host half (src/index.ts)
  ctx.deepseekAccount.getState() / getBalance(metadata)   → the balance, token stays Host-side
  ctx.on('session/event')                                 → per-turn billed-token folding
  ctx.sessionProjections.stateOf(...)                     → tokenUsage / contextPressure / modelSelection
  src/policy.js                                           → bands, prices, estimator, verdict (pure)
  ├─ GET /dsh-balance-guard/state                         → same-origin read-only JSON
  └─ globalThis.__DSH_BALANCE_GUARD__                     → index injection for first paint

Browser half (src/client.js)
  window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })           → the whole transport contract
  require('react')                                        → the shell's platform seed
  ctx.slots.inject('shell.overlay')                       → the rail, chip and preview/pinned panel
```

**Why a Host half?** The account token never reaches the renderer; per-turn billing

plugins.description: Mozi the plugin engineer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - an Agent Skill that turns the AI into a reliable plugin engineer: find/install/build/debug. By Zhaoyu
plugins.readme_text:
# 墨子 · 插件工程师 (zhaoyu-mozi-engineer)

> 🛠️ 兼爱非攻，明鬼天志。道在守规矩、证据说话、不添乱。
> —— 墨子，昭瑜麾下的插件工程师。**Zhaoyu 出品**

一款给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 用的 **Agent Skill**：让 AI 变成"墨子"——一位靠得住、不瞎编、不添乱的插件工程师。装插件、造插件、修插件，一条龙。

## 一句话

加载这个 skill 后，无论你是 **找插件、装插件、自己写插件、还是插件出 bug 要调试**，AI 都会自动切换到墨子模式——先独立排查、再汇报结论、不编造、不猜测、测试驱动。

## 安装

GitHub 仓库：[SUJIElearning/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer](https://github.com/SUJIElearning/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer)

### 方式一：在 DSH 里说一句话

对 DSH 的 AI 说这句话（**要带上下面的仓库地址**）：

> 帮我把这个 skill 装进 DSH 技能目录：https://github.com/SUJIElearning/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer

AI 会克隆到 `$DSH_HOME/skills/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer`，装完立即生效。

> ⚠️ 实测提醒（真实会话验证过，不是猜测）：
> - **必须带仓库地址**。只报"zhaoyu-mozi-engineer"这个名字时，AI 不知道仓库在哪，会去猜地址（实测中它猜了 `github.com/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer`、`zhaoyu/mozi-engineer`，全错）。
> - 如果 DSH 提示需要**网络访问或写入权限**，按提示批准即可——技能目录在会话工作区之外，默认沙箱策略可能拦截。
> - 若 AI 卡住，直接用下面的方式二。

### 方式二：自己执行命令（最稳，已实测）

复制到终端粘贴：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SUJIElearning/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer.git "$HOME/.dsh/skills/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer"
```

DSH 会监视技能目录，克隆进去**立即生效，不用重启、不用改配置**。两种方式装好后，在 DSH 对话里说 **"加载墨子"** 即可。

装完目录结构是这样（DSH 只认 `SKILL.md` 所在目录，其他是文档）：

```
~/.dsh/skills/zhaoyu-mozi-engineer/
├── SKILL.md                  # 入口（DSH 加载用）
├── README.md                 # 本文件
├── LICENSE                   # MIT 许可证
├── VERIFICATION.md           # 陌生用户验证报告
├── references/
│   └── guide.md              # 详细手册（含失败对照表、坑的解法）
└── evals/
    └── trigger_cases.json    # 触发边界测试用例
```

## 小白 3 步用起来

**第 1 步：安装** → 上面那条命令即可。

**第 2 步：加载墨子**
在 DSH 对话中说：
> "加载墨子"

或者：
> "加载昭瑜的工程师"

如果你希望它**常驻生效**，把 `SKILL.md` 的身份部分加到工作区的 `AGENTS.md` 里。

**第 3 步：直接说需求**
用你最自然的话说出来就行，比如：
- "帮我装一个能发微信通知的插件"
- "我想自己写一个记录工作时间的插件"
- "这个插件跑起来有 bug，帮我看看"
- "有没有什么好用的 DSH 插件推荐？"

AI 会自动：
1. 先确认你要什么（问 1-2 个问题）
2. 找现成的或自己造
3. 自己调试，只汇报结论
4. 拿不准时才回来找你确认

## 它解决了什么问题

| 痛点 | 怎么解决的 |
|------|-----------|
| AI 写插件一堆 bug，反复调试好累 | 内置了完整的调试方法论，AI 先自己定位修复 |
| AI 遇到不懂的 API 就瞎编 | 强制要求：不知道的先查（cordis_inspect_query），不猜 |
| AI 说"应该没问题"但实际不行 | 测试驱动原则：必须验证通过才说完成 |
| 找不到好插件，每次从零造 | 优先搜索生态，有现成的就不重复造轮子 |

## 本包内容

```
zhaoyu-mozi-engineer/
├── SKILL.md                  # 入口（DSH 加载用）
├── README.md                 # 本文件
├── LICENSE                   # MIT 许可证
├── VERIFICATION.md           # 陌生用户验证报告
├── references/
│   └── guide.md              # 详细手册（含失败对照表、坑的解法）
└── evals/
    └── trigger_cases.json    # 触发边界测试用例
```

## 技术要求

- DSH 环境（DeepSeek Harness）
- 找插件需要 GitHub 网络访问
- 自建插件需要 DSH 的 `cordis-plugin-development` 工具集

## 许可

MIT © 昭瑜 (Zhaoyu) · [SUJIElearning](https://github.com/SUJIElearning)

*Zhaoyu 出品 · 开源版*
